digest.component_or_area: nginx edge proxy / app container forwarded-headers trust boundary
propositions: nginx edge surfaces /review/, /opcert/, and Gerrit's location / lack guaranteed scheme preservation on Location response headers emitted by upstream services, allowing https requests to receive http:// Location downgrades

review-bot and opcert containers run behind nginx with FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS unset, causing uvicorn to distrust the X-Forwarded-Proto: https header from the bridge-gateway peer and build absolute http:// URLs instead of https
Gerrit builds absolute Locations from canonicalWebUrl config rather than request scope, so it emits https Locations already but relies on unenforced config rather than a proxy-level guarantee
proxy_redirect http-to-https rules must be added per-location (never server-level) to each of the three surfaces to backstop any upstream that could emit a plaintext Location header

FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS: '*' must be set on review-bot and opcert services so they trust nginx's forwarded-proto and stop building http:// URLs at the source, bounded by loopback publication and nginx overwriting client-supplied values
the fix merged at commit 25fd2cf6dd75 but was never deployed; autodeploy.sh has no manifest entry for infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template, so nginx config regeneration does not occur on autodeploy cycles
